scope: Infrastructure and smoke incidents; these are not additional trained configurations

incidents.symptom: FlashInfer JIT could not find ninja because native venv PATH was inactive

incidents.symptom: Finite gradient but no adapter update: first warmup learning rate was0

incidents.symptom: TRL free-port probe raced with another run; EADDRINUSE23456 before any optimizer step
incidents.fix: Explicit MASTER_PORT29600+GPU slot; retry used29602, completed startup

incidents.symptom: Triton l2norm_bwd_kernel.cubin missing at load, file present afterward under shared vLLM AOT compile cache
incidents.diagnosis: Transient shared-cache race is consistent with evidence; exact deleting writer is not proven. vLLM persistently overrides inductor cache root.
incidents.fix: Retry from original base with per-slot VLLM_CACHE_ROOT, TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR, TRITON_CACHE_DIR; no shared cache deletion
